name: zeffect_update_beam_node_between_fractions
description: zEffect::UpdateBeamNodeBetweenFractions positions and scales an Object3D beam between fractional points on a source-to-destination segment.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native beam update tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x458ce0 validates start/end interpolation from t0/t1, start-position set, Vec3DirectionAnglesBetweenPoints rotation path, existing x/y scale preservation, fractional segment length approximation, z-scale update, and returned length.
The native parent/attach/detach smoke verifies fractional start position, preserved x/y scale, z-scale length, and returned length for the middle half of a four-unit beam.
